evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and updates CMake compiler checks, CI configurations, and compiler minimum baselines across build files.
rationale: Bumping minimum Clang to 19 allows dropping obsolete compiler workarounds and enables C++20 CTAD for alias templates. As noted in the description, 'Most supported operating systems ship with clang-19 (or later), so bump the minimum to that and allow new code to drop workarounds for previous clang bugs.' This is a standard compiler baseline modernization without urgent platform breakage or deadline pressure.
